dimensions.assessment: Affects federal employees eligible for awards, agency chief financial officers, and administrative personnel handling disclosures.
dimensions.evidence: The head of an agency may pay a cash award to any employee of such agency whose identification of wasteful expenses... has resulted in cost savings

dimensions.assessment: Doubles the maximum possible cash award from $10,000 to $20,000 and establishes formal internal reporting and review processes.
Aims to generate cost savings and prevent financial losses through waste identification and potential rescissions, while increasing possible cash award payouts.
dimensions.evidence: has resulted in cost savings for the agency or prevented a payment that, if made, would be an improper payment resulting in financial loss to the Government

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal statute governing agency awards, mandates OMB guidance, and institutes reporting requirements for executive agencies and congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Director of the Office of Management and Budget, in coordination with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management and the Secretary of the Treasury, shall issue guidance

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent program expansions and recurring reporting requirements across federal agencies.

missing_information: Total projected government-wide savings or award expenditures
Number of federal employees expected to participate
importance_detail.rationale: This bill expands federal employee incentive awards for identifying wasteful operational expenses and improper payments, doubles the maximum award amount, and requires agencies to process and report these findings.
